Applied.description: Whether the frame applied an effect its settings ask for.

CellStats.description: World streaming's state after the last extraction.

pending.description: Cells within range still waiting to load.

rows.description:
Rows of the clouds' dome this frame marched: all of them on exact
frames, a slice on ordinary ones, none without clouds.

view_pixels.description:
Pixels of the view whose clouds this frame marched, a ray each: its
render size's, none without clouds or with their march in the view
off.

CullingStats.description: What GPU culling ran and left undrawn.

active.description:
Whether this GPU-presented display frame ran it, without an instance
budget (occlusion culling draws in two phases around its test).

instances.description:
Visible instances it left undrawn (occluded, or covering no pixel
center), read back with the visible count; `None` otherwise.

stamps.description: Stamps this frame pressed into the map around the camera.

texels.description:
The map's texels along a side: 0 while off, fewer than the settings'
where the device's buffers cannot hold them.

dropped_impostors.description:
Opaque draw groups that qualified for impostors but draw their meshes
because a budget or the GPU's texture array layers left them none.

impostor_instances.description: Instances drawn as impostors, read back like `lod0_instances`.

impostors.description:
Impostors resident: loaded from their records, or baked where no
pack or store held them.

lod0_instances.description:
GPU-culled frames with levels of detail: instances drawn as their
mesh, read back with the visible count; `None` otherwise.

lod1_instances.description:
Instances drawn as their mesh's first simplification, read back like
`lod0_instances`.

lod2_instances.description:
Instances drawn as their mesh's second simplification, read back like
`lod0_instances`.

meshes_without_levels.description:
Resident meshes that could have levels of detail drawing without:
no pack or store held the levels the cook makes
(`cargo xtask cook`).

Drawn.description: What a feature drew, and what a budget or the GPU's bindings left out.

dropped.description: Items a budget or the GPU's bindings left out.

invalid.description: Items breaking their rules, which no frame draws.

active.description:
Whether it scaled this frame: a display frame with dynamic resolution
on.

budget_ms.description: The milliseconds of GPU time frames keep within, while active.

scale.description:
The scale the frame drew at on each axis, of the size the resolution
policy and the user's scale give: 1 while inactive.

active.description: Whether this frame metered its exposure.

metered.description:
The meter's average of the light in view before exposure, in
hundredths of a stop (log2 of linear light), read back alike.

stops.description:
The exposure frames show, in hundredths of a stop above the
atmosphere's authored exposure (below it when negative), read back a
few frames late; 0 in frames not metering.

view.description:
How much brighter the view is than the light falling on level
ground gives an open view, in hundredths of a stop, read back alike:
negative in a cave by day.

blades.description: Blades the last read-back frame drew.

dropped.description: Blades past the capacity or budget, which dropped.

reach.description: Meters from the eye ground cover reached this frame, rounded.

tiers.description:
The most tiers it grew in: the first's, out to where blades span a
pixel, and doublings past it.

JobStats.description: Workers, their jobs and the host's output cache.

cache_hits.description:
Records the host's packs and store handed back instead of running
their jobs.

cache_mismatches.description: Verifying, records differing from a fresh run.

failed.description:
Jobs failed. A record fetched alone that no pack or store holds
([`MISSING_RECORD`]) is no failure: its owner makes it.

held.description:
Jobs the host's scheduler holds: on its workers, or looked up in its
packs and store. None once every job handed out ended, an earlier
engine's included.

in_place.description:
Jobs run in place: by a host without workers, or an engine no host
serves.

running.description: Jobs handed out and not done.

cluster_overflow.description:
Cluster entries beyond the clusters' budget or the storage still
growing, read back like `visible`.

dropped.description: Usable lights beyond the budget or without a valid pose.

invalid.description: Lights breaking their rules, which no frame draws.

shaded.description: Local lights the frame shaded within the budget.

visible.description:
Lights that reached a view cluster, read back a few frames late;
`None` before the first read-back or without lights.

NavStats.description:
What navigation did at the last fixed tick: agents, and
those searching (and of them those waiting for records or their
terrain's bakes), walking, arrived and unable to reach their
destination; the samples of search work the tick did; and the tiles'
grounds and portals held for walks.

grounds.description: Tiles whose ground navigation holds for walks.

portals.description: Tiles whose portals of a walk graph navigation holds.

searching.description: Agents whose walk is being searched.

unreachable.description: Agents whose destination no walk reaches.

waiting.description:
Agents whose search waits for records the host has yet to hand
back, or for its terrain's bakes.

work.description: Samples of search work the tick did.

OccupancyStats.description: The occupancy maps around the detail eye.

averages.description:
Times a map took the mean of the finer one inside it where that one
changed.

redraws.description:
Times a map redrew cells: each follows the detail eye in steps and
redraws where objects change.

PhysicsStats.description: Physics at the last fixed tick, read when the stats are.

awake.description: Of them, awake: moving, or pushed this tick.

contacts.description: Contacts touching between bodies and solids or each other.

held.description:
Of them, held still where the world's solids under them are not
resident yet.

solids.description:
The world's solids the solver holds for bodies to meet: terrain
tiles, placed objects and colliders near them.

water_samples.description: Samples of the world's water the tick's bodies took.

dropped.description: Probes a budget or the GPU's texture array layers left out.

ready.description: Probes surfaces could reflect this frame.

ResolutionStats.description:
The frame's sizes: the display's, which the surface or canvas and every
screen-sized target take, and the one it drew at from their top-left
corner, which its last pass upscaled to the display.

display_height.description: The display's height in physical pixels.

display_width.description:
The display's width in physical pixels: the host's whole view, unless
the device's largest texture holds less, which the display then fits
within at its aspect.

dropped_pixels.description:
Pixels of the view the host asked for that the device's largest
texture left out of the display.

gpu_ms.description:
Milliseconds the GPU took over the last frame it timed, from two
timestamps around its work, read back a few frames late; `None`
where the device times no work.

render_height.description: The height the frame drew at in physical pixels.

render_width.description:
The width the frame drew at in physical pixels: the resolution
policy's for the view at the user's scale, within the display, times
dynamic resolution's scale; the display's own for debug views and
exact frames.

active.description: Whether the sun cast shadows this frame.

casters.description:
Casters the redrawn tiles drew, read back a few frames late; `None`
before the first read-back.

draws.description:
Indexed draws into the clipmap's tiles, beside the camera pass's
`draw_calls`.

moving_casters.description:
Moving casters' draws into the tiles they cross, read back like
`casters`.

moving_left_out.description:
Moving casters' draws into tiles they cross that their draw groups'
room left out, read back like `casters`.

moving_tiles.description: Tiles moving casters drew over this frame.

sky_drawn.description:
Sky occlusion's maps this frame drew: one at most, while the camera
strays from them or their still meshes change.

sky_maps.description:
Sky occlusion's maps of still meshes seen from the sky
(`sky_occlusion`), drawn around the camera: two per direction in use
at most, and until a direction's are drawn it counts as open sky.

tiles_marked.description:
Tiles the pixels read back latest read, at the levels their size on
screen picks: those the clipmap draws.

tiles_missing.description:
Tiles pixels read that hold no drawn slot yet, for want of slots or
of the redraw budget: lookups read a coarser level there.

tiles_reclaimed.description: Kept tiles whose slots this frame gave to tiles pixels read.

tiles_resident.description:
Tiles holding a slot of the atlas: those pixels read and those kept
from before while slots last.

SkyStats.description: The physically based sky, and the exposure frames show.

exposure.description: Auto exposure's meter, which replaces the sky's own adaptation.

tables.description:
Tables this frame uploaded or built: two when its air's tables
arrived, one more when the sun, the camera's height or the air
changed; none without the sky.

dropped.description:
Terrains whose bounce light the horizon maps' layers or the probes'
buffers could not hold this frame, which take none.

levels.description:
The most levels of probes a terrain's bounce light relit this frame:
those whose reach meets the terrain, the coarsest always.

probes.description:
The probes bounce light relit this frame, over every level around
the detail eye.

relit.description:
Terrains whose bounce light relit this frame: every frame, however
the sun and sky stand.

dropped_materials.description:
Surface materials past the palette's capacity, or whose maps the
shared arrays cannot hold (block compressed, or sized unlike the first
material's), which show a plain color instead.

dropped_placed_objects.description:
Placed objects the device's storage bindings left out: those past
what the objects' buffers hold, and entries past what the views'
lists hold, once each view and level leaving them out, read back a
few frames late.

dropped_tiles.description: Tiles the tile budget or the device's texture array layers dropped.

fallback_tiles.description:
Tiles the camera's view draws and shows that are not resident yet,
whose ground coarser tiles stand in for.

gpu_controls.description: Tiles the GPU gave control values this frame.

horizons.description: Terrains casting long sun shadows through horizon maps.

leaves.description:
Leaves of the terrains' subdivisions the camera drew, as read back a
few frames later.

lighting_uploads.description:
Maps of terrains' lighting this frame uploaded, as it arrived or
changed: sky and horizon maps, one each per terrain. The sun moving
uploads none.

macro_maps.description:
Terrains whose macro color maps are here: the tint and growth their
bakes give their ground.

placed_far_objects.description:
Of those, objects standing far away, which hide where the tiles
holding them instead are resident.

placed_impostors.description:
Placed objects' impostors resident, which the camera draws far away
and shadow maps cast as cards; counted in `level_of_detail.impostors`
too.

placed_objects.description:
Objects placement layers stand on resident level-0 tiles, each culled
on the GPU every frame.

refused_splits.description:
Splits the subdivisions refused for want of room for their leaves
(`TerrainSettings::subdivision_leaves`), as read back: the ground
there stays coarser.

shadow_patches.description: Patches the shadow clipmap's regions drew of the ground.

shallow_subdivisions.description:
Terrains whose subdivision the device's storage bindings keep
shallower than `TerrainSettings::subdivision_depth` asks.

sky_maps.description: Terrains whose sky visibility maps are here.

white_water.description:
Emitters of spray and mist white water spawned at terrains' rapids,
where their settled water loses energy fastest.

VirtualGeometryStats.description: Virtual geometry, read back a few frames late.

dropped.description: Cluster selections dropped while their storage grew.

dropped_pages.description:
Wanted pages (with arrivals since) that found no room under the
budget or the device's limits.

failed_pages.description:
Page reads that failed or held no valid page since streaming
started, each read again later; the renderer's
`latest_page_failure` says why the latest did.

missing_pages.description:
Pages the last read-back frame wanted and lacked: 0 once its view had
all the detail it asked for.

occluded_clusters.description: The camera's clusters occlusion culling left undrawn.

visibility_buffer.description:
Whether the visibility buffer resolved the camera's virtual geometry
rather than drawing it forward.

WaterStats.description:
Terrains' water, as their tiles hold it and as it runs live around the
detail eye.

blocks.description: Blocks of tiles' water resident on the GPU, a patch's each.

dropped_blocks.description:
Blocks this frame dropped for want of the device's texture array
layers, whose water does not draw.

dropped_particles.description:
Particles that frame's pools had no room for, born or left by a wave
splitting: the foam and the waves there go undrawn.

dropped_touches.description:
Solids standing in that square past the most its water takes, which
push none of it.

foam_particles.description:
Foam particles living in that window, white water and the foam the
water carries, as read back a few frames late.

leaves.description:
Leaves of terrains' water's subdivisions the last read-back frame
drew, a few frames late.

live_behind.description:
Steps the simulation time passed held this frame past the most a
frame takes, by which the live water fell behind the clock.

live_budget_cut.description:
Cells along a side of the square the live reach asks for
(`engine_core::LIVE_PIXELS`) that the budget of its cell steps a
frame cuts from it (`Water::live_budget`): the live water then
hands back to the settled water nearer the eye.

live_cells.description:
Cells along a side of the square around the detail eye over which
water runs live this frame: 0 while none does (before its first
square is gathered).

live_cut.description:
Cells along a side of the square the budget holds that the device's
storage bindings cut from it, the middle square they hold running
instead: the live water then hands back nearer the eye still.

live_steps.description:
Steps the live water took this frame, each of the same seconds, the
longest in which its fastest water and waves cross a quarter of its
cells: as many as the simulation time passed holds, at most those of
a frame a thirtieth of a second long.

particle_texels.description:
Texels along a side of the window around the detail eye that the
particles terrains' water carries splat into: 0 while none run; as
many as reach out to where its texels span a pixel, or fewer where
the display's pixels or the device's storage bindings cut them, and
its texels span more there. Its pools hold a particle for every few
of its texels.

particles_born.description:
Particles born in the frame last read back, foam and waves together:
where the water breaks and churns, where it runs against what stands
in it, and where the window newly covers its water or its current
carries foam in across the window's rim.

refused.description:
Splits terrains' water's subdivisions refused for want of room for
their leaves (`Water::subdivision_leaves`), as read back a few frames
late: the water there stays coarser.

touches.description:
Solids standing in that square whose push its water takes this
frame, nearest the eye first: bodies and colliders, at most
`SIM_TOUCHES`.

wave_particles.description:
Wave particles living in that window, as read back a few frames
late.

description:
CPU observations from the last submitted frame and the renderer's report
of it. Render time is not GPU time.

culled_instances.description: Valid instances culling proved outside the view.

disabled_features.description:
The renderer's features it disabled for good, by name: one whose
creation failed validation, or that an uncaptured GPU error named
by its objects' labels. Frames render without them.

draw_calls.description:
Draw commands of the camera's mesh passes, each counted once however
many occlusion phases issue it: each opaque mesh group's, one per
level of detail on GPU-presented frames, the impostors', virtual
geometry's forward bins and the transparent groups'. `shadows.draws`
counts the shadow maps'.

dropped_instances.description: Visible instances the instance budget left undrawn.

dropped_seconds.description: Total simulation time discarded by the fixed-step budget in this session.

dynamic_resolution.description: Dynamic resolution's scale of the size frames draw at.

extraction_ms.description: Milliseconds the frame spent extracting the render snapshot.

fixed_steps.description: Fixed simulation ticks this frame ran.

frame.description: The frame these stats describe, as `FrameTime::frame` counts it.

haze.description: The haze's march: the sunlight the near air scatters.

instances.description:
Number of mesh instances submitted (before GPU clipping). GPU-culled
frames report the read-back visible count limited by the instance
budget, or the budgeted candidate count before any read-back.

invalid_transforms.description:
Renderable entities skipped because their derived transform is
invalid.

jobs.description: The host's workers and their jobs, read when the stats are.

loading.description:
Whether terrains have yet to load the camera's view whole, or a
record game code's content waits for (its generated meshes and
textures), a static table the scene wants or its pipeline list has
yet to arrive, read when the stats are: hosts keep preparing
meanwhile.

mesh_upload_bytes.description: Vertex/index bytes initialized for meshes first seen this frame.

missing_assets.description:
Renderable entities skipped because a mesh, material, or texture is
absent.

navigation.description: Navigation agents at the last fixed tick, read when the stats are.

physics.description: Rigid bodies at the last fixed tick, read when the stats are.

pipelines_compiling.description:
Whether the GPU may still be compiling pipelines earlier frames
created, read when the stats are.

pipelines_created.description:
Pipelines this frame created: 0 once everything the scene draws is
compiled.

pipelines_listed.description:
Pipelines the scene's pipeline list created up front, while the
session prepared.

pipelines_unlisted.description:
Pipelines the session created that the scene's pipeline list
lacked, once it arrived: 0 while the list holds every pipeline the
session draws with.

read_back_age.description:
GPU-culled frames only: how many GPU-presented frames late the counts
read back with the visible count (`instances`, `triangles`,
`occlusion_culling`, `subpixel_culling` and `level_of_detail`'s
instances) are, 1 when they arrived as soon as they could, more while
the GPU falls behind; `None` before the first read-back. A check that
changed what they count presents until this is below the frames it
presented since.

render_candidates.description: Every entity carrying a mesh, before transform and asset checks.

render_ms.description: Milliseconds the frame spent preparing and submitting GPU work.

render_passes.description: The passes this frame ran, in order.

resident_mesh_bytes.description: Vertex/index bytes retained on the GPU after this frame.

resident_meshes.description: Number of distinct meshes retained on the GPU.

resident_texture_bytes.description: Asset texel bytes retained on the GPU after this frame.

resident_textures.description: Number of asset textures retained on the GPU, excluding renderer white.

resolution.description: The display's size and the size the frame drew at.

simulation_ms.description: Milliseconds the frame spent in fixed and variable simulation.

sky.description: The physically based sky, and the exposure frames show.

texture_upload_bytes.description: Texel bytes uploaded for textures first seen this frame.

tick.description:
The last fixed tick that frame completed, as `FixedTime::tick`
counts it.

triangles.description:
Triangles the camera's mesh draws submitted, at their levels of
detail and impostors' two each: exact on CPU-prepared frames, read
back with the visible count on GPU-culled ones. Virtual geometry
counts its own in `virtual_geometry.triangles`.

upload_bytes.description:
Actual bytes uploaded or initialized: changed camera/instances and new
assets. An unchanged rendered frame can submit draws with zero upload
bytes. Excludes renderer startup resources such as the four-byte white
texture.

visible_instances.description:
Valid instances surviving culling, before the instance budget;
GPU-culled frames report the latest read-back count.

title: FrameStats
